title: 4.6 mono regression, cant build project, or play scenes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6 Beta 2 .NET. 
Not Reproducible in 4.5.1 Mono

### System information

Windows 10, Godot 4.6

### Issue description

Opening a working .NET project produces this error log
it is impossible to play the game, or build the C# solution.
Removing all C# code, removing the visual studio solution, project, anything related to C# or the solution does not seem to solve the issue.
